# v1.21.3b3 — House-load availability correction (beta)

This development beta supersedes v1.21.3b2 for testing. It removes the amplitude-only positive-step filter, which could repeatedly report unknown power and omit genuine short, ramping or changing household loads.

## Changes

- Accept finite non-negative house-load balances immediately, without waiting for a stable level. Large positive changes alone no longer manufacture unknown readings.
- Retain the negative-balance guard and its original 10-second estimate limit. Failed or missing reads do not qualify for a held power estimate. Existing mode/SoC safety checks and dispatch deadlines remain in place.
- Keep a known daily accumulated amount numeric during power-data gaps. `accumulation_paused: true` and `incomplete_day: true` identify missing coverage. Stop adding unmeasured energy after the estimate expires; do not backfill outages or invent an initial zero.
- Preserve midnight, backwards-clock and same-day restore safeguards. No additional Modbus requests, register-encoding changes or PredBat code/configuration changes are included.

## Remaining limitations

This removes the artificial gaps caused by v1.21.3b2's positive-step confirmation rule. It does not guarantee that power will always be numeric: prolonged negative balances and genuinely missing/failed reads can still produce unknown power. Consumers that substitute zero for unknown power can still report warnings in those cases.

Positive artifacts caused by asynchronous register updates remain unresolved and can also be held during a subsequent negative balance. These derived readings are estimates, not an independent consumption meter. Historical statistics and already omitted consumption are not repaired. [Issue #10](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/issues/10) remains open.

## Validation

448 Python tests pass in each of HA 2024.12.5 / Python 3.12 and HA 2026.10.4 / Python 3.14 with pymodbus 3.7.4. All 23 dashboard tests pass, with GitHub HACS and hassfest validation. Coverage includes real HA state publication, short/ramping/cycling loads, negative-balance expiry, source outages, midnight, clock changes and restoration. Tests are isolated from hardware; they do not certify every inverter or automation.

Stable remains v1.21.2. This is a development prerelease, not a stable promotion.
